DoomBlastPlayer.description: Deal Chaos damage in an area around the previously Cursed enemy.
DoomBlastPlayer.name: Doom Blast

SupportAbidingHexPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do.
SupportAbidingHexPlayer.name: Abiding Hex

SupportAcrimonyPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
SupportAcrimonyPlayer.name: Acrimony

SupportAddedChaosDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.
SupportAddedChaosDamagePlayer.name: Chaos Attunement

SupportAddedColdDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.
SupportAddedColdDamagePlayer.name: Cold Attunement

SupportAhnsCitadelPlayer.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a Fissure, at the cost of damage and Area of Effect.
flavourText: As possessed golems ravaged the land, Aul - crowned Ahn
by blood and tyranny - began the last ritual, causing azurite
crystals to rupture and grow throughout his doomed citadel.
SupportAhnsCitadelPlayer.name: Ahn's Citadel

SupportAmbrosiaPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of Damage as extra Lightning Damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.
SupportAmbrosiaPlayer.name: Ambrosia

SupportAmbushPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Critically Hit enemies on full life.
SupportAmbushPlayer.name: Ambush

SupportArbitersIgnitionPlayer.description: Supports Fire Spell Skills. You have a chance to gain Flame Archon when Igniting with Supported Skills.
flavourText: "This carving seems to depict curled bodies floating in vats...
the next shows all but one of them dying. What were they
trying to do? It seems they kept trying... kept experimenting..."
SupportArbitersIgnitionPlayer.name: Arbiter's Ignition

SupportArcaneSurgePlayer.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.
SupportArcaneSurgePlayer.name: Arcane Surge

SupportAstralProjectionPlayer.description: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.
SupportAstralProjectionPlayer.name: Astral Projection

SupportAtzirisAllurePlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you.
flavourText: Such was her seductive power, every noble in the court fell
over themselves to do her bidding. Winning a single glance
away from her mirror meant more than their lives.
SupportAtzirisAllurePlayer.name: Atziri's Allure

SupportBiddingPlayer.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.
SupportBiddingPlayer.name: Bidding I

SupportBiddingPlayerThree.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.
SupportBiddingPlayerThree.name: Bidding III

SupportBiddingPlayerTwo.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.
SupportBiddingPlayerTwo.name: Bidding II

SupportBitingFrostPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.
SupportBitingFrostPlayer.name: Biting Frost

SupportBoneShrapnelPlayer.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.
SupportBoneShrapnelPlayer.name: Bone Shrapnel

SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayer.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.
SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayer.name: Boundless Energy I

SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayerTwo.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.
SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayerTwo.name: Boundless Energy II

SupportBurgeonPlayer.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.
SupportBurgeonPlayer.name: Burgeon I

SupportBurgeonPlayerTwo.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.
SupportBurgeonPlayerTwo.name: Burgeon II

SupportBurningRunesPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.
SupportBurningRunesPlayer.name: Burning Inscription

SupportCatharsisPlayer.description: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition. Does not support Triggered Skills.
SupportCatharsisPlayer.name: Catharsis

SupportChaosMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportChaosMasteryPlayer.name: Chaos Mastery

SupportChaoticFreezePlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
SupportChaoticFreezePlayer.name: Chaotic Freeze

SupportChillingIcePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.
SupportChillingIcePlayer.name: Frost Nexus

SupportClarityPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportClarityPlayer.name: Clarity I

SupportClarityPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.
SupportClarityPlayerTwo.name: Clarity II

SupportColdExposurePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when it Critically Hits an enemy.
SupportColdExposurePlayer.name: Cold Exposure

SupportColdMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportColdMasteryPlayer.name: Cold Mastery

SupportColdPenetrationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.
SupportColdPenetrationPlayer.name: Cold Penetration

SupportCommandment.description: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.
SupportCommandment.name: Commandment

SupportConcentratedAreaPlayer.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.
SupportConcentratedAreaPlayer.name: Concentrated Area

SupportConsideredCastingPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.
SupportConsideredCastingPlayer.name: Considered Casting

SupportControlledDestructionPlayer.description: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.
SupportControlledDestructionPlayer.name: Controlled Destruction

SupportCorpseConservationPlayer.description: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.
SupportCorpseConservationPlayer.name: Corpse Conservation

SupportCracklingBarrierPlayer.description: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.
SupportCracklingBarrierPlayer.name: Crackling Barrier

SupportCrazedMinionsPlayer.description: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.
SupportCrazedMinionsPlayer.name: Crazed Minions

SupportCrystallineShardsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Damaging Explosions caused by Ice Crystals from Supported Skills will Impale Enemies.
SupportCrystallineShardsPlayer.name: Crystalline Shards

SupportCurseEffectPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.
SupportCurseEffectPlayer.name: Heightened Curse

SupportCursedGroundPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.
SupportCursedGroundPlayer.name: Cursed Ground

SupportDanseMacabrePlayer.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.
SupportDanseMacabrePlayer.name: Danse Macabre

SupportDeathmarchPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Persistent Minions. Supported Minions will restore Life to nearby Allied Minions on death, as well as removing Ailments from those Minions.
SupportDeathmarchPlayer.name: Deathmarch

SupportDecayingHexPlayer.description: Supports Curse skills. Cursed enemies' bodies decay, taking Chaos damage over time.
SupportDecayingHexPlayer.name: Decaying Hex

SupportDerangePlayer.description: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.
SupportDerangePlayer.name: Derange

SupportDiallasDesirePlayer.description: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.
flavourText: "I will become your Gemling Queen, my love, but not
with such dull stones. I want to give myself to you
for eternity. Surely we can seek perfection together?"
SupportDiallasDesirePlayer.name: Dialla's Desire

SupportDoedresUndoingPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create Hazardous areas which explode when Enemies enter them, Cursing Enemies and dealing Chaos Damage based on your Intelligence.
flavourText: "Let the meat show us the way. Hail the meat, praise the
meat. The meat is both debasement and divinity alike. The
meat shall lead us down the path to true enlightenment."
SupportDoedresUndoingPlayer.name: Doedre's Undoing

SupportDrainedAilmentPlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.
SupportDrainedAilmentPlayer.name: Drain Ailments

SupportElementalArmyPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
SupportElementalArmyPlayer.name: Elemental Army

SupportElementalDischargePlayer.description: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions.
SupportElementalDischargePlayer.name: Elemental Discharge

SupportElementalFocusPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.
SupportElementalFocusPlayer.name: Elemental Focus

SupportEmbitterPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.
SupportEmbitterPlayer.name: Embitter

SupportEncroachingGroundPlayer.description: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.
SupportEncroachingGroundPlayer.name: Encroaching Ground

SupportEnergyBarrierPlayer.description: Supports any skill that you can use, causing Energy Shield recharge to begin immediately if you are Stunned while using it.
SupportEnergyBarrierPlayer.name: Energy Barrier

SupportEnergyCapacitorPlayer.description: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.
SupportEnergyCapacitorPlayer.name: Energy Capacitor

SupportEnergyRetentionPlayer.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.
SupportEnergyRetentionPlayer.name: Energy Retention

SupportEnergyShieldOnShockKillPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.
SupportEnergyShieldOnShockKillPlayer.name: Shock Siphon

SupportEshsRadiancePlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.
flavourText: "Where life once thrived, now only metal grows, inching
like endless worms through the ash. Where silence fell,
now sourceless thought whispers numbers in the dark."
SupportEshsRadiancePlayer.name: Esh's Radiance

SupportEssenceHarvestPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.
SupportEssenceHarvestPlayer.name: Essence Harvest

SupportExcisePlayer.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportExcisePlayer.name: Excise

SupportExecratePlayer.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportExecratePlayer.name: Execrate

SupportExpansePlayer.description: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportExpansePlayer.name: Expanse

SupportExtractionPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.
SupportExtractionPlayer.name: Extraction

SupportFeedingFrenzyPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.
SupportFeedingFrenzyPlayer.name: Feeding Frenzy I

SupportFieryDeathPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it Ignites to have a chance to explode on death.
SupportFieryDeathPlayer.name: Fiery Death

SupportFireMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportFireMasteryPlayer.name: Fire Mastery

SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.
SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayer.name: Harmonic Remnants I

SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.
SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayerTwo.name: Harmonic Remnants II

SupportFlukePlayer.description: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.
SupportFlukePlayer.name: Fluke

SupportFlukePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.
flavourText: Few mortals can comprehend the horror of experiencing
every possibility. Chaos alone takes joy in the
unthinkable and the unimaginable made manifest.
SupportFlukePlayerTwo.name: Ixchel's Torment

SupportFocusedCursePlayer.description: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.
SupportFocusedCursePlayer.name: Focused Curse

SupportFreezePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.
SupportFreezePlayer.name: Freeze

SupportFreezeforkPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.
SupportFreezeforkPlayer.name: Freezefork

SupportFrostfirePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Freeze on Igniting a Frozen enemy to boost the effect of the Ignite.
SupportFrostfirePlayer.name: Frostfire

SupportGlacierPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.
SupportGlacierPlayer.name: Glacier

SupportHexBloomPlayer.description: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.
SupportHexBloomPlayer.name: Hex Bloom

SupportHinderPlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time, causing damage over time they inflict to also Hinder enemies. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.
SupportHinderPlayer.name: Hinder

SupportHourglassPlayer.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportHourglassPlayer.name: Hourglass

SupportHulkingMinionsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.
SupportHulkingMinionsPlayer.name: Hulking Minions

SupportIceBitePlayer.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses all of your Attacks with Cold damage for a short time.
SupportIceBitePlayer.name: Ice Bite

SupportIciclePlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.
SupportIciclePlayer.name: Icicle

SupportIncreasedCriticalDamagePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.
SupportIncreasedCriticalDamagePlayer.name: Supercritical

SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayer.description: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.
SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayer.name: Inevitable Critical

SupportIntenseAgonyPlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.
SupportIntenseAgonyPlayer.name: Intense Agony

SupportKalisasCrescendoPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.
flavourText: "Her voice reached into my chest and plucked my beating
heart from its cage. By the wide, glistening eyes of my
fellow punters, I knew that they felt it, too."
SupportKalisasCrescendoPlayer.name: Kalisa's Crescendo

SupportKulemaksDominionPlayer.description: Supports Offering Skills, causing Spells that affect an area around you or a target location to also affect the area around Supported Offerings.
flavourText: Still a shadow of his former self, Kulemak turned to deception.
He promised Ahn untold power and mastery, in exchange for
a single golem. "After all, what harm could one servant do?"
SupportKulemaksDominionPlayer.name: Kulemak's Dominion

SupportKurgalsLeashPlayer.description: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.
flavourText: Kurgal's first body was a mere stone golem, enslaved by a
collar. He found such ecstasy in the power of dominion,
he clawed his way free... and soon, supplanted a Lich Lord.
SupportKurgalsLeashPlayer.name: Kurgal's Leash

SupportLastGaspPlayer.description: Supports skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration or when they take further damage exceeding their maximum Life.
SupportLastGaspPlayer.name: Last Gasp

SupportLastingFrostPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.
SupportLastingFrostPlayer.name: Deep Freeze

SupportLightningMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportLightningMasteryPlayer.name: Lightning Mastery

SupportLivingLightningPlayer.description: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
SupportLivingLightningPlayer.name: Living Lightning

SupportLivingLightningPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
SupportLivingLightningPlayerTwo.name: Living Lightning II

SupportLoyaltyPlayer.description: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.
SupportLoyaltyPlayer.name: Loyalty

SupportMagneticRemnantsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.
SupportMagneticRemnantsPlayer.name: Magnetic Remnants

SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayer.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.
SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayer.name: Magnified Area I

SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger at the cost of damage.
SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayerTwo.name: Magnified Area II

SupportManaFlarePlayer.description: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to trigger a Mana Flare on Critical Hit. The Mana Flare consumes your Mana to deal Fire damage. Cannot support the skills of Minions.
SupportManaFlarePlayer.name: Mana Flare

SupportManaFountainPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana which will Leech Mana to Allies within it.
SupportManaFountainPlayer.name: Font of Mana

SupportManaLeechPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.
SupportManaLeechPlayer.name: Mana Leech

SupportMinionInstabilityPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.
SupportMinionInstabilityPlayer.name: Minion Instability

SupportMinionMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Minion skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportMinionMasteryPlayer.name: Minion Mastery

SupportMinionPactPlayer.description: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.
SupportMinionPactPlayer.name: Minion Pact I

SupportMinionPactPlayerTwo.description: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.
SupportMinionPactPlayerTwo.name: Minion Pact II

SupportMusterPlayer.description: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.
SupportMusterPlayer.name: Muster

SupportMysticismPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportMysticismPlayer.name: Mysticism I

SupportMysticismPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportMysticismPlayerTwo.name: Mysticism II

SupportNadirPlayer.description: Supports Skills which gain Stages or Seals. Supported Skills have lower Maximum Stage or Seal count, but have a Minimum Stage or Seal count they cannot fall below.
SupportNadirPlayer.name: Nadir

SupportPhysicalMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.
SupportPhysicalMasteryPlayer.name: Physical Mastery

SupportPinpointCriticalPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.
SupportPinpointCriticalPlayer.name: Pinpoint Critical

SupportPotentExposurePlayer.description: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.
SupportPotentExposurePlayer.name: Potent Exposure

SupportPotentialPlayer.description: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Power Charge on use if possible, and will be much more likely to Critically Hit if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Power Charges.
SupportPotentialPlayer.name: Potential

SupportProfanityPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do. Cannot support Triggered Skills or Reservation Skills.
SupportProfanityPlayer.name: Profanity I

SupportProfanityPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed. Cannot support Triggered Skills or Reservation Skills.
SupportProfanityPlayerTwo.name: Profanity II

SupportRapidCastingPlayer.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.
SupportRapidCastingPlayer.name: Rapid Casting I

SupportRapidCastingPlayerThree.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast Recently.
SupportRapidCastingPlayerThree.name: Rapid Casting III

SupportRapidCastingPlayerTwo.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.
SupportRapidCastingPlayerTwo.name: Rapid Casting II

SupportRimePlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing Enemies Chilled by those Surfaces to be more easily Frozen, but at the cost of some Chill magnitude.
SupportRimePlayer.name: Rime

SupportRitualisticCursePlayer.description: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.
SupportRitualisticCursePlayer.name: Ritualistic Curse

SupportSacrificalOfferingPlayer.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.
SupportSacrificalOfferingPlayer.name: Sacrificial Offering

SupportSacrificialLambPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing your skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill.
SupportSacrificialLambPlayer.name: Sacrificial Lamb I

SupportSacrificialLambPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing your skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.
SupportSacrificialLambPlayerTwo.name: Sacrificial Lamb II

SupportShockConductionPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.
SupportShockConductionPlayer.name: Shock Conduction

SupportSpellCascadePlayer.description: Supports Spells that affect an area around you or a target location, causing those Spells to also target additional areas on either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis. Cannot support Channelling skills or Remote skills.
SupportSpellCascadePlayer.name: Spell Cascade

SupportSpellEchoPlayer.description: Supports Spells that affect an area around you or a target location. Supported Spells echo, causing their effects to happen again after a short delay. Cannot support Channelling skills Remote skills or skills which are Triggered.
SupportSpellEchoPlayer.name: Spell Echo

SupportStormfirePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, prolonging Shocks they inflict on Ignited enemies.
SupportStormfirePlayer.name: Stormfire

SupportStrongHeartedPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportStrongHeartedPlayer.name: Strong Hearted

SupportTecrodsRevengePlayer.description: Supports skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration or when they take further damage exceeding their maximum Life. Minions from Supported Skills gain Soul Eater and a burst of speed on entering this state.
flavourText: The Lich Lords destroyed his body, but with his dying fury,
Tecrod found a way. He lurks deep, in the blood, in the flesh,
in the Well... perhaps walking among them even now, unseen.
SupportTecrodsRevengePlayer.name: Tecrod's Revenge

SupportTempestuousTempoPlayer.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.
SupportTempestuousTempoPlayer.name: Rising Tempest

SupportUnbendingPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Mana, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Cast time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
SupportUnbendingPlayer.name: Unbending

SupportUnleashPlayer.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown.
SupportUnleashPlayer.name: Unleash

SupportUpwellingPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportUpwellingPlayer.name: Upwelling I

SupportUpwellingPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportUpwellingPlayerTwo.name: Upwelling II

SupportVarashtasBlessingPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that can deal Damage, causing it to deal more Damage per different Command Skill used.
flavourText: "These traditions we shall set forth, so that we may remain
strong, so that we may endure throughout the ages. Not to
bind, not to dominate, but to protect... and guide."
SupportVarashtasBlessingPlayer.name: Varashta's Blessing

SupportVerglasPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.
SupportVerglasPlayer.name: Verglas

SupportVilentasPropulsionPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.
flavourText: Day and night, she hammered away, obsessed with proving it
could be done; a vast ring of artifice under the earth, pushing
energy to speeds never before seen - all to prove Qotra wrong.
SupportVilentasPropulsionPlayer.name: Vilenta's Propulsion

SupportVolatilePowerPlayer.description: Supports Skills which you use yourself. On using Supported Skills while they are Empowered, you gain Volatility.
SupportVolatilePowerPlayer.name: Volatile Power

SupportVolatilityPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.
SupportVolatilityPlayer.name: Volatility

SupportWallFortressPlayer.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.
SupportWallFortressPlayer.name: Fortress I

SupportWallFortressPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.
SupportWallFortressPlayerTwo.name: Fortress II

SupportWildfirePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.
SupportWildfirePlayer.name: Wildfire

SupportWildshardsPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.
SupportWildshardsPlayer.name: Wildshards I

SupportWildshardsPlayerThree.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.
flavourText: She holds in her hand a shattered crystal, a vision of her desire: to
see her sister's silver palace obliterated, to see it cast across the
heavens. One cross word, and the sky will rain down her fury.
SupportWildshardsPlayerThree.name: Sione's Temper

SupportWildshardsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.
SupportWildshardsPlayerTwo.name: Wildshards II

SupportWitheringTouchPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.
SupportWitheringTouchPlayer.name: Withering Touch

SupportZarokhsRefrainPlayer.description: Supports Spells that affect an area around you or a target location. Supported Spells echo twice, causing their effects to happen again after a short delay, but Supported Skills are given a short Cooldown. Cannot support Channelling skills, Remote skills, skills which already have a Cooldown, or skills which are Triggered.
flavourText: Reliving the same day for all time, Zarokh raged against
the moments that made up his prison. There would be
no redemption, for he had broken his only barya.
SupportZarokhsRefrainPlayer.name: Zarokh's Refrain

SupportZenithPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportZenithPlayer.name: Zenith I

SupportZenithPlayerTwo.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana, and Recoup a portion of Skill costs as Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportZenithPlayerTwo.name: Zenith II

TriggeredBoneShrapnelPlayer.description: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the maximum Life of the Pinned target slain.
TriggeredBoneShrapnelPlayer.name: Bone Shrapnel Explosion

TriggeredBurningRunesPlayer.description: Create Ignited Ground Igniting Enemies based on a percentage of your Maximum Mana.
TriggeredBurningRunesPlayer.name: Burning Inscription

TriggeredCurseZoneHazardExplosionPlayer.description: Explodes and deals Chaos Damage based on your Intelligence when an Enemy enters the area, applying the supported Curse on Hit.
TriggeredCurseZoneHazardExplosionPlayer.name: Doedre's Dark Design

ViciousHexSupportPlayer.description: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.
ViciousHexSupportPlayer.name: Impending Doom
